target: direct log return T+1..T+5; displayed price is current raw close × exp(calibrated conditional-median log return)

governance.priceSourcePolicy: VNStock primary -> Yahoo adjusted corporate-action reference/fallback -> last-good cache
governance.eventPIT: Publication-time aligned historical archive. Only article fields available at publishedAt/availableDate enter features; T+h event outcomes become priors only after their maturity date. Retrospective search coverage is audited separately from forward ingestion availability.
governance.rumorPIT: Rumor claim truth-state is UNVERIFIED until a later official/clarification item becomes available. Confirmation or denial is never backfilled to dates before the resolution publication.
governance.entityResolution: Ambiguous ticker-language collisions pass only explicit ticker/company/brand rules; raw ticker-token coincidence is insufficient.
governance.flowPIT: Completed-EOD institutional flow archive. Feature at T uses only observations dated <= T; missing foreign/proprietary coverage has explicit availability flags. V12 CafeF archive is required for final promotion because community VNStock does not expose sponsor flow methods on the runner.
governance.fundamentalPIT: Accounting-statement numerical features remain disabled unless an independently audited filing/publication timestamp archive exists. FUNDAMENTAL_EVENT is publication-time earnings/financing event evidence, not look-ahead quarterly statement ratios.
governance.survivorship: Current HOSE is augmented in training only by independently confirmed former-HSX delisted members retaining VCI product_grp_id=STO and real stale price history. Unknown prior-exchange delisted rows are never guessed.
governance.stacking: Base experts generate chronological OOF predictions; meta learner is trained only on OOF predictions.
governance.expertPromotion: Optional expert requires evidence coverage, positive delta IC and MAE, plus one-sided multiple-testing-controlled daily IC evidence in the pre-sealed 70-80% selection block. Sealed ablation never selects an expert.
governance.modelSelection: Ridge vs LightGBM/HGB selected before the 80% lock.
governance.calibration: 80-85% quantile/isotonic calibration; 85-90% split-conformal correction; final 90-100% sealed audit. Each 85%/90% boundary removes h sessions from the preceding labelled block so T+h labels cannot mature in the following block.
governance.modelRisk: CSCV/PBO is computed from chronological OOF expert predictions and is a hard generalization gate; literal expanding-window replay refits experts at historical T0 with horizon purge.
governance.sealedAudit: Final 90-100% block reports ranking/direction/scenario metrics, daily IC stability, regime diagnostics and expert ablations; it is not used to tune the production model.

dataSources.flowSource: CafeF historical foreign quarterly JSON + proprietary full-range XLSX

skillGatePolicy.ranking: rankIC > 0.02; spread > 0.10%; >=20 daily IC observations; >=50% non-negative daily IC
skillGatePolicy.direction: balanced accuracy > 0.51; MCC > 0.015; Brier skill > 0; ECE < 0.12
skillGatePolicy.scenario: scenario rank IC > 0.01; scenario MAE improvement over zero-return baseline > 0; empirical CQR coverage 52%-72%
skillGatePolicy.rule: A forecast that is worse than the no-change/base-rate baseline cannot be promoted merely because rank IC is positive.

embargoAudit.policy: Each row is admitted only if its actual symbol-specific T+h label maturity date is strictly before the next lock boundary; sampled-origin ordinal distance is not used as a proxy for h trading sessions.

distributionAudit.calibrationSplitPolicy: 80-85% quantile/isotonic; first half of maturity-purged 85-90% selects strictly-positive return shrink via a pre-blind one-standard-error rule; second half computes conformal widening; 90-100% remains sealed.
distributionAudit.expectedReturnDefinition: conditional median q50 after pre-blind shrink calibration
distributionAudit.priceConversion: raw close * exp(calibrated q50 log return)

pboAudit.method: CSCV 8 blocks / 4 train blocks over the admissible production selection path; optional families appear only after pre-sealed promotion

walkForwardReplay.method: Expanding-window literal replay. Every expert fit uses only labels whose symbol-specific T+h maturity date is strictly before replay T0. Meta uses chronological OOF labels matured before the 80% lock. Quantile/isotonic/conformal layers are frozen from maturity-embargoed 80-90% calibration blocks.

fixedBlindHoldout.method: FIXED_MODEL_SEALED_90_100: within this training run, model-family/expert selection/meta fitting are locked before the holdout and quantile/isotonic/conformal calibration is frozen before the 90% boundary. The frozen forecast is evaluated on four chronological 90-100% sub-blocks without refitting. This is a fixed sealed evaluation partition for the current run, not a claim that the dates were never inspected across earlier V12 development iterations.
fixedBlindHoldout.policy: No user-facing price is valid unless this fixed sealed holdout, literal walk-forward replay, distribution calibration, ranking skill, PBO/generalization and maturity embargo all pass. Forward live snapshots remain the strongest genuinely unseen evidence.
